overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted academic and professional social media presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, with a total of 3,580 followers. Content is highly specialized, focusing on computational social science, disinformation, coordinated inauthentic behavior, and academic opportunities. Across all 7 posts, there is exceptionally high engagement, indicating an active, deeply invested audience that responds well to research milestones, tool releases, and recruitment opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of peer-reviewed papers, tool updates (like CooRnet v2.0), and methodological approaches to studying online disinformation.
Recruitment of PhD candidates and postdoctoral researchers for computational social science projects.
Sharing presentations, upcoming conferences like DisinfoConf2025, and high-level academic discussions.

recommendations: Leverage Bluesky's highly active audience to post multi-post threads breaking down complex research papers into more digestible, visual summaries.
Utilize LinkedIn's larger, professional network to share broader impact stories from funded research grants, linking tools like CooRnet directly to real-world policy impact.
Incorporate relevant academic and community hashtags on Mastodon to increase the discoverability of tool releases and academic discussions outside the immediate follower network.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky is the most interactive platform, yielding the highest average engagement rate (6.14%). Users are exceptionally responsive to new publications and educational opportunities, showing high ratios of reposts relative to likes.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides a dedicated, highly niche community that values technological updates and platform debates. It shows steady engagement (4.55% average) but lower absolute volume compared to other platforms.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn represents the largest audience (1,850 followers) and generates the highest absolute interaction counts. It is the premier platform for professional milestones, grant awards, and recruitment, with strong comment sections indicating deeper professional dialogue.
